welcome_message:
Welcome! I am a bot that manages access to private chats via cryptocurrency payments.

Here's how it works:
1. Use the `/pay <chat_id>` command (or just `/pay` inside a managed group) to get payment instructions.
2. Send the specified amount of USDT (on the TRC-20 network) to the provided wallet.
3. Send the transaction hash back to me in this private chat.
4. I will verify the payment and grant you access to the chat.

To see your active subscriptions, use the /status command.
For a full list of commands, use /help.
help_pay: Start the payment process for a chat. Can also be used inside the target chat without the ID.
help_status: Check the status of your active subscriptions.
help_addchat: (run in group) Adds a new chat to be managed.
help_delchat: (run in group or with ID) Removes a chat from management.
help_chats: Lists all managed chats and their settings.
status_no_subscriptions: You do not have any active subscriptions.
error_owner_only: Only the owner can use this command.
error_admin_only: You are not authorized to use this command.
addadmin_already_admin: This user is already an admin.
addadmin_success: User {user_id} has been added as an admin.
list_chats_no_chats: No chats are currently being managed.
delchat_private_chat_error: Use /delchat <chat_id> in a private chat, or just /delchat in the target group chat.
delchat_success: Chat with ID {chat_id} is no longer managed.
addchat_private_chat_error: Please use this command in the group chat you want to add.
addchat_already_managed: This chat is already being managed.
addchat_ask_amount: What is the payment amount for this chat in USDT? (e.g., 10.5)
addchat_invalid_amount: Invalid amount. Please enter a number.
addchat_ask_duration: How many days of access does this grant? (e.g., 30)
addchat_invalid_duration: Invalid duration. Please enter a whole number of days.
addchat_success:
Success! Chat '{chat_title}' has been added.
Amount: {amount} USDT
Duration: {duration} days
pay_private_chat_error: Please specify a chat ID with /pay <chat_id> or use this command in the group you want to pay for.
pay_chat_not_managed: This chat is not registered for payment.
pay_already_active: You already have an active subscription for this chat until {date}.
pay_instructions:
To get access to '{chat_title}' for {duration} days, please send:

Amount: `{amount}` {currency}
To Wallet: `{wallet}`
Network: TRON (TRC-20)

After sending the payment, please reply here with the transaction hash (TxID).
handle_tx_invalid_hash: That doesn't look like a valid transaction hash. A hash is a 64-character string. Please try again.
handle_tx_verifying: Received your transaction hash. I will now verify it. This may take a moment.
verify_chat_not_found: Error: The chat you are trying to pay for no longer exists.
verify_tx_used: This transaction hash has already been used. Please make a new payment.
verify_tx_not_found_on_chain: Transaction not found. Please wait a few minutes for it to appear on the blockchain.
verify_tx_too_old: This transaction is too old. It must be within the last {minutes} minutes.
verify_explorer_connection_error: Could not connect to the blockchain explorer. Please try again later.
verify_explorer_connection_error_details: Could not connect to the blockchain explorer to verify details. Please try again later.
verify_no_transfer_events: Could not find any transfer events for this transaction. Please ensure it's a valid USDT payment.
verify_payment_not_confirmed: Payment not confirmed. I was looking for a transfer of at least {amount} {currency} to `{wallet}`, but couldn't find it.
verify_payment_confirmed:
✅ Payment confirmed\!

You have been granted access to *{chat_title}* until {date} UTC\.
verify_invite_link_generated:
Here is your personal invite link to join:
{invite_link}
verify_invite_link_failed: Could not create an invite link. Please contact an admin to be added to the chat manually.
verify_internal_error: An internal error occurred. Please contact an admin.
renewal_reminder:
Hi! Your subscription for the chat '{chat_title}' is expiring in {days} days.
To renew your access, please use the /pay {chat_id} command.
removal_notification: Your access to '{chat_title}' has expired. You have been removed from the chat. You can use /pay {chat_id} to regain access.
